verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform covering contract creation, workflows, signing, storage and contract AI. Preparing and submitting state annual reports or registered-agent compliance filings is outside that product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Ironclad offers such filings. Its workflow APIs and AI analysis concern contracts, not entity compliance filings, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
